candidates.description: This feature represents empirical research concepts and the evaluation of scientific evidence.
This feature vector detects common German prefixes and word fragments.
This feature represents German pronouns, conjunctions, and connective adverbs commonly used in subordinate clauses and formal text.
This vector represents word fragments and prefixes associated with German vocabulary and compound nouns.
This feature vector activates strongly in response to mental health conditions, psychiatric terms, and related medical or psychological concepts.
This vector activates on prefixes of neuroscience and biological or medical terminology.
This vector represents numbers, specifically within a sequential range from single digits to the upper twenties.
This vector activates in contexts related to law, legality, and regulation.
This vector represents first-person plural pronouns and related pronominal forms across multiple languages.
This vector represents active German verbs primarily in the third-person present tense.
